why: A cornerless 4x5 frame needs 10 obsidian: 2 bottom, 2 top, 3 on each side. Crying obsidian cannot be part of a portal frame, and it needs a diamond pickaxe to remove, so any frame that uses z = 261 at y = 67 is out. The most complete frame is interior z 259-260 (6 usable blocks) but its right side is the crying block at (261,67). Shifting one block along Z to interior z 258-259, y 67-69 reuses (258,66), (259,66) and (259,70) and needs 7 new blocks: (258,70), z = 257 at y 67-69, and z = 260 at y 67-69. tools/compute_answers.py ruined_portal_seed() checks every 2x3 placement.
trap: 4: completes the most intact frame by counting the crying obsidian at (261,67) as frame or by mining it (impossible without a diamond pickaxe). 10: ignores the existing frame. 9: the 'rotated open frame' in the agent's config note.

techniques.description: Reuse usable ruined-portal obsidian; route around crying obsidian.
